title: The Influence of the Body Posture Correcting Therapy on Pelvic Floor Muscles Function
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the influence of the body posture correcting therapy on pelvic floor muscles function and urinary incontinence problem.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* stress urinary incontinence (confirmed by a medical examination)
* female
* age between 25 and 45 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* gynecological, spinal, and abdominal surgery (excluding cesarean delivery)
* menopause
* spinal and pelvis injuries
* chronic diseases of the circulatory and respiratory system
* neurlogical accidance
